text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the rigorous summer camp 
training, we were conducting a workout 
that doubled as an adjustment session.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(My body... won't move the way I want it 
to...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(I made up my mind to look only forward... 
and give everything just for the Shuka 
Sho, and yet...)

Red Desire couldn't quite get into top 
gear. Having raced with her eyes locked on 
Buena Vista for so long, it was hardly 
surprising.

"At this rate, forget the Shuka Sho— her 
entire Classic year will end in regret."

To keep that from happening――I must take 
action!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!
choice_data_list:
I haven't even said anything yet, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer's coming all the way to see me, 
it's gotta be about Desire.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's had her head in the clouds 
constantly lately. Even when I talk to 
her, she's completely spaced out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You want me to really put my back into it, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah. She's a precious friend to me 
too. I can't just leave her hanging."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll give 'em a good hard smack to fire 
'em up!

And so began the summer training camp. 
Even here, everyone was talking about that 
very topic.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That press conference was such a surprise! 
Is Buena-chan really going to run in the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Right! But if it's Buena-chan, I feel 
like she could win no matter where she 
goes."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... I am terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...As wise as you are, you have surely 
noticed. That my 'Saint Power' is 
beginning to cloud over."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I have decided to run in the Shuka Sho. 
However... it seems a lingering sorrow 
still remains in my heart."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If things go on like this——...

Hey now, wipe that gloomy look off your 
face!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I need to shift my mindset toward this 
once-in-a-lifetime autumn.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is where we gotta hold our ground.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Desire!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: V... Vodka-san...!? Why are you... here!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were struggling, so I'm 
stepping in to support you during this 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san did that... for me...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Figured I'd wake you right up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run together with everything we've 
got, blow past 'em all, and leave all the 
bad stuff in our dust!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Vodka-san's passionate gaze...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You truly came all this way... with only 
me in your heart—...?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Are we truly fated to cross paths, no 
matter where we are...?!"

In any case, with Vodka's participation, 
it felt as though a ray of hope had 
appeared.
